title: Snow Miser Portrait
description: A theatrical female character with pale skin and white curly hair stands dramatically against a swirling purple and yellow sky, wearing an elaborate icy blue and silver coat with snowflake patterns and icicle details. She wears a tall crystalline crown, holds a snowflake-topped scepter in one hand while raising the other, with scattered Christmas cards and a 'Snow Miser' title floating in the wintry scene.
prompt: A theatrical Snow Miser character with pale skin and curly white hair stands in a dramatic pose against a swirling purple and yellow cosmic sky filled with snowflakes and ice. She wears an elaborate long coat in icy blue and silver with snowflake patterns, fringe, and icicle details, plus a tall crystalline blue crown. One hand is raised casting magic while the other holds a tall staff topped with a large snowflake. Scattered vintage Christmas cards and gift tags float around her feet in the snow, with the text 'Snow Miser' in icy lettering above.
